node.title: Bound sparse circuits selected by a codimension-two quotient line
node.closure: catalecticant determinant alternative, bounded-degree cofactor kernel map, and fixed-root fiber incidence
node.statement: For a ten-dimensional V<=F[X]_<12, every rank-ten eleven-set selects one point on the projective quotient line P(V^perp). Full-rank circuits of support one through five in a selected m-set are bounded by sum_c Q_c(m)C(m-c,11-c), where Q_1=2 and Q_c is the exact determinant/cofactor fiber cap. At m=67484 this gives 11868577829520852215896202871552159662636920 per record, without assuming that a secant-contained quotient line has fixed support.
